gates.notes: Imported script from At the Crossroads (Take 2).

gates.name: Gate B: 8-Point Director Visual Continuity Gate
gates.notes: Imported panels already approved in the original project.

panels.name: A suited executive dismissively hands a demo
panels.summary: A suited executive dismissively hands a demo tape back to the Kid.
panels.caption: No label would sign him.
panels.qaNotes: Imported from At the Crossroads (Take 2): panel approved in the original project.

panels.name: The Kid plays in a nearly empty,
panels.summary: The Kid plays in a nearly empty, run-down Western honky-tonk.
panels.caption: He grinded the run-down honky tonks town to town, singing to near-empty rooms like somebody cared.
panels.qaNotes: Imported from At the Crossroads (Take 2): panel approved in the original project.
panels.originalCaption: He grinded the run-down honky tonks town to town, singing to near-empty rooms like somebody cared.

panels.name: Closing time
panels.summary: Closing time. An old itinerant bluesman sits alone drinking.
panels.caption: One night the only man who stayed till closing was an old itinerant bluesman.
panels.qaNotes: Imported from At the Crossroads (Take 2): panel approved in the original project.
panels.originalCaption: One night the only man who stayed till closing was an old itinerant bluesman.

panels.name: The Bluesman gestures with his pipe, grinning
panels.summary: The Bluesman gestures with his pipe, grinning wickedly.
panels.caption: He told the kid he had the ache but talent alone doesn't sell -
panels.qaNotes: Imported from At the Crossroads (Take 2): panel approved in the original project.
panels.originalCaption: He told the kid he had the ache but talent alone doesn't sell -

panels.name: A mythological visual of a man standing
panels.summary: A mythological visual of a man standing at an empty dirt crossroads meeting a shadow.
panels.caption: - and then told him about the crossroads.
panels.qaNotes: Imported from At the Crossroads (Take 2): panel approved in the original project.
panels.originalCaption: - and then told him about the crossroads.

panels.name: The Bluesman leans in close, lit by
panels.summary: The Bluesman leans in close, lit by a neon sign.
panels.caption: Stand at midnight where two roads cross, wait for the Devil, sign your name in blood, and the fame starts today.
panels.qaNotes: Imported from At the Crossroads (Take 2): panel approved in the original project.
panels.originalCaption: Stand at midnight where two roads cross, wait for the Devil, sign your name in blood, and the fame starts today.

panels.name: The Kid listens intently, conflicted
panels.caption: He owns your soul when you die, but you get everything you want in the meantime.
panels.qaNotes: Imported from At the Crossroads (Take 2): panel approved in the original project.
panels.originalCaption: He owns your soul when you die, but you get everything you want in the meantime.

panels.name: The Bluesman stares right through him
panels.summary: The Bluesman stares right through him.
panels.caption: And he warned: the Devil always comes back to collect - you won't grow old.
panels.qaNotes: Imported from At the Crossroads (Take 2): panel approved in the original project.
panels.originalCaption: And he warned: the Devil always comes back to collect - you won't grow old.

panels.name: The Kid walks out, laughing, throwing his
panels.summary: The Kid walks out, laughing, throwing his guitar case in his truck.
panels.caption: The kid heard him out, laughed him off as a drunk with a tale, packed up, and hit the road.
panels.qaNotes: Imported from At the Crossroads (Take 2): panel approved in the original project.
panels.originalCaption: The kid heard him out, laughed him off as a drunk with a tale, packed up, and hit the road.

panels.name: The Kid drives into the night with
panels.summary: The Kid drives into the night with hands on the wheel. Up ahead under the headlights is a dark rural crossroads. In the rearview mirror, his calm eyes are reflected.
panels.caption: Seed planted and forgotten.
panels.shotType: Interior truck cab, Driver POV looking over the steering wheel and dashboard through the windshield at night
panels.qaNotes: Imported from At the Crossroads (Take 2): panel approved in the original project.
